notes.title: About this game
notes.content:
SARE Inception: Action RPG game set in a visually stunning fantasy universe full of meaningful choices and impactful consequences.
Dangerous caves, Creatures, Hidden Passages, Fantastic Villages, Giant Creatures and Action are waiting for you in this game.
Help sare find her brother in fantastic scenes.
This game consists of 6 sections where 3 are combined.
Use Arrow, Sword and Ax.
Find the secret boxes for health and open them.
UPDATE
--------------------------------------------------------------
This action game is under development.
We will not charge you for monthly updates.
Extra levels and items will arrive in the update.
Looking forward to your story and level suggestions.
